summary: @ornikar/rollup-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) is an obfuscated Node script (hex-prefixed identifiers, per-function string-lookup tables) that downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun (pinned to v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it with a sibling file `math_init.js` as its script. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte Bun-compiled (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) blob using shuffled string-array obfuscation (`WV8StW` rotator with a >4000-element mixed-value dictionary) that resists static analysis. The payload is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a Rollup configuration helper); the main entry `createRollupConfig.js` is a clean rollup config and does not reference `math_init.js` or `setup.mjs`. Bringing in an alien runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated blob that the Node/npm ecosystem cannot introspect is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: on `npm install`, arbitrary attacker-controlled code executes on the installer's machine outside normal ecosystem visibility.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
